title: Mask layer rendering: clip canvas to mask layer shapes
description: Flash 8 mask layers (type='mask') clip the rendering of their associated 'masked' layers beneath them. Implement in the Canvas 2D renderer (packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts): (1) When iterating layers for rendering, identify mask+masked layer pairs: a mask layer clips all consecutive masked layers directly below it in the layer stack; (2) For each mask layer, render its shapes into a separate off-screen canvas, then use ctx.clip() or globalCompositeOperation='destination-in' to restrict the masked layers to only paint within the mask shape bounds; (3) Mask layer itself is not visible — only the clipping region counts; (4) The mask only clips during SWF playback/export too — update packages/swf/src/compile.ts to emit PlaceObject2 with ClipDepth field for masked layers (ClipDepth = depth of the last masked layer). Layer.type values: 'mask' (the clipper) and 'masked' (clipped by the mask above). Wire guide layer visibility too: 'guide' and 'guided' layers — the guide layer itself is not rendered in SWF output (only guides during authoring). Add tests: packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/mask.test.ts — verify mask layer causes render isolation, verify guide layer excluded from SWF output. Only touches packages/core/src/engine/ and packages/swf/src/ — no authoring-ui changes needed.
